capabilities.title: Video generation from text prompts or image inputs
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Pixelle Video: text-to-video and image-to-video generation model
capabilities.reason: Pixelle Video requires substantial GPU compute; Nexus is free/local and does not have a video generation lane. Cloud video generation APIs would also require paid subscriptions.

capabilities.title: Video understanding: frame analysis, caption generation, and scene segmentation
capabilities.reason: If Nexus adds a video intelligence lane, Pixelle Video patterns for frame analysis and caption generation could be adapted. Deferred pending a video lane decision.

capabilities.title: Integrate video context into LLM prompts alongside text and images
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Pixelle Video multimodal context: video frames as LLM input
capabilities.reason: Nexus supports text and image context; video frame context integration is a future multimodal capability.
